credits_text: Written by Tim Entertainment in association with 10-Inked Productions. A film by Jaclyn Chessin. "Shock Attack" starring Anita Penny, Andrew Fiorenza, Ashlyn Elizabeth Allen and Jessica Starble. Costume Design by Masquerade Henri. Music by Ma. Mundshine and Richard Evans.
moderation_notes: Contains intense horror elements and implied violence.
description: A dark, menacing creature emerges from a stormy, electric environment, set against twisted trees and a night sky.
